fieldQuestion.source: 只用这套电极，能把标准全头64导的信号还原到什么程度？
fieldQuestion.en: How well can these electrodes reconstruct the signals at the standard 64-channel layout?

sensitivityQuestion.source: 对相对接收最弱的那部分脑源，信号幅度还剩多少？
sensitivityQuestion.en: How much signal amplitude remains for the sources this layout detects least well relative to the reference?

localizationQuestion.source: 根据收到的信号，能多好地判断脑源来自哪里？
localizationQuestion.en: How well can the recorded signals reveal where a brain source is located?

jointPass.source: 三项均达到最低保留要求。
jointPass.en: All three metrics meet the minimum required retention.

incomplete.source: 有 {{0}} 项无法判断，尚不能确认三项共同达标。
incomplete.en: Metrics awaiting assessment: {{0}}. The joint requirement is not yet confirmed.

jointFail.source: 尚未三项共同达标；下方分别显示达标项和差距。
jointFail.en: The joint requirement is not met. See each metric's status and margin below.

requirement.source: 本次最低保留要求：{{0}}% · 三项分别判断
requirement.en: Minimum required retention: {{0}}% · applied to each of the three metrics

equal.source: 恰好达到最低保留要求
equal.en: Exactly meets the minimum required retention

smallSurplus.source: 超过要求不足0.01个百分点
smallSurplus.en: Above the requirement by less than 0.01 percentage points

smallShortfall.en: Below the requirement by less than 0.01 percentage points

surplus.source: 超过要求 {{0}} 个百分点
surplus.en: Above the requirement by {{0}} percentage points

shortfall.en: Below the requirement by {{0}} percentage points

jointDefinition.source: G取三项最低值，仅用于三项联合判断；单项达标不代表三项共同达标。
jointDefinition.en: G is the minimum of the three metrics and is used only for their joint assessment. Passing one metric does not satisfy the joint requirement.
